room_rent.display: 1% of SI/day (Premier); Deluxe Room (Elite ≤25L); Any Room (Elite 50L+, Signature 25L+)
room_rent.note: Premier Plan: 1% of SI/day up to ₹7,500–₹10,000 depending on SI. Elite Plan: Deluxe Room for SI ₹5L–₹25L, Any Room for SI ₹50L. Signature Plan: Deluxe Room for SI ₹5L–₹20L, Any Room for SI ₹25L+. Room Rent Enhancement to Any Room available as optional add-on for Elite & Signature (SI ₹5L–₹20L).

icu.display: No cap (ICU charges covered as part of SI)
icu.note: ICU charges are listed as covered inpatient expenses with no separate sub-limit mentioned; covered up to sum insured across all plans.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in the base policy for any plan.

sub_limits.display: Cataract, Bariatric, Robotic surgery, Road/Air ambulance, Newborn, Delivery, ART, Sleep disorders capped
sub_limits.note: Cataract: ₹25K–₹75K (Premier/Elite), Actuals (Signature). Bariatric: ₹2L–₹6L. Robotic surgery sub-limits on Premier. Road ambulance: ₹2,500–₹5,000 (Premier), ₹5,000–₹10,000 (Elite), Actuals (Signature). Newborn: 10% of SI. Delivery: 10% of SI up to ₹2L. ART: ₹1L–₹5L. Modern treatments: sub-limits on Premier plan.

deductible.display: None (optional aggregate or per-claim deductible available)
deductible.note: No inbuilt deductible. Optional aggregate deductible (₹25K/₹50K/₹1L) or per-claim deductible (₹5K/₹10K) available for Elite and Signature plans with premium discounts.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day initial waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.display: 36 months (reducible to 12mo via optional PED Buy Back on Signature)
ped_waiting.note: 36 months for 1-year and 2-year policy terms across all plans. 3-year policy term: 25 months for Signature Plan, 36 months for Premier and Elite. Optional PED Buy Back (Signature only) can reduce to 12 or 24 months. Insta Care Cover (Signature optional) waives PED waiting for Asthma, BP, Cholesterol from 31st day.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24 months for 1-year and 2-year policy terms across all plans. 3-year policy term: 18 months for Signature Plan, 24 months for Premier and Elite. Covers cataract, ENT, thyroid, hernia, joint replacements, gynaec conditions, etc.

maternity.display: Covered – Signature Plan only (2yr wait; up to 10% SI or ₹2L)
maternity.note: Delivery expenses (normal & C-section, pre/post-natal) covered only in Signature Plan up to 10% of SI or ₹2L whichever is less. Waiting: both spouses covered 2 years continuously, or insured woman alone 4 years. Max 2 deliveries lifetime. Not covered in Premier or Elite plans.

cumulative_bonus.note: Premier: 25% after first claim-free year, then 10%/yr, max 100%. Elite: 50% after first claim-free year, then 25%/yr, max 150%. Signature: 100% after first claim-free year, then 25%/yr, max 500%. Alternatively, No Claim Discount (non-cumulative) can be chosen instead of CB.

restoration.note: Premier: No restoration. Elite: Once per policy year, 100% of SI, for different/unrelated illness only; modern treatments and accidents excluded. Signature: Unlimited restorations, 100% of SI each time, for same or different illness including modern treatments and accidents. Unutilised restoration not carried forward.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for the number of days immediately before hospitalisation as per plan.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for the number of days immediately after discharge as per plan.

day_care.display: All day-care procedures covered up to SI
day_care.note: All day-care procedures covered across all three plans up to sum insured.

domiciliary.display: Covered up to SI (with exclusions for certain conditions)
domiciliary.note: Covered across all plans up to sum insured for treatment >3 days. Excludes asthma, bronchitis, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, psychiatric disorders, arthritis, gout, and several other conditions.

ayush.display: Covered up to SI (inpatient AYUSH hospital)
ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient treatment covered up to sum insured across all plans. Yoga and Naturopathy claims require prior company approval.

organ_donor.display: Covered – Signature Plan only (donor complications + insured donation)
organ_donor.note: Organ Donor Expenses inbuilt only in Signature Plan. Covers donor's redo surgery/ICU complications (additional SI up to basic SI) and insured person's expenses if they donate an organ. 24-month waiting period. Not available in Premier or Elite plans.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance limits vary by plan. Air ambulance: Not covered (Premier); 10% of SI up to ₹2.5L/yr (Elite); 10% of SI (Signature). Air ambulance for India only.

modern_treatments.display: Sub-limited (Premier); Covered up to SI (Elite & Signature)
modern_treatments.note: Premier: Robotic surgeries sub-limited (₹4L–₹7L depending on type, or 30% SI for others). Elite and Signature: All modern treatments covered up to sum insured. Includes robotic surgery, immunotherapy, stem cell therapy, intravitreal injections, deep brain stimulation, oral chemotherapy, etc.

consumables.note: List I consumables (gloves, nebuliser kit, oxygen cylinder, etc.) covered inbuilt in Signature Plan. Available as optional paid cover for Elite Plan. Not available for Premier Plan.

global_cover.note: Territorial limit is India only. Air ambulance also restricted to India. No international/overseas treatment cover mentioned.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud or permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: Grace period of 15 days for monthly premium payment mode and 30 days for quarterly, half-yearly, annual, and other instalment modes.

free_look.note: Free-look period of 30 days from date of receipt of policy document for new policies. Not applicable on renewals or portability/migration.

portability.note: Portability allowed as per IRDAI norms. Credits for PED waiting, specific waiting periods, moratorium, and no-claim bonus transferable to acquiring insurer.

notable_exclusions.display: Hazardous sports, circumcision, congenital external defects, chelation/EECP/hyperbaric O2 therapy, PRP injections, biologicals (OPD), vaccination (non-post-bite)

optional_riders.display: Personal Accident (AD&PTD), Hospital Cash, PED Buy Back, Insta Care (31-day PED waiver), Aggregate/Per-claim Deductible, Room Rent Enhancement, Consumables (Elite), Premium Promise (Elite)
